All application requirements of the project, one line each.

## Requirements

- **REQ-001** — Catalog listing. A shopper browses the products on offer. *(Source: Catalog)*
- **REQ-ACC-001** — Sign-up. A visitor opens an account with an email address. *(Source: Account)*
- **REQ-ACC-003** — Password reset. An account holder sets a new password over a mailed link. *(Source: Account)*
- **REQ-CART-001** — Cart holds items. A shopper keeps picked items until checkout. *(Source: Cart, draft)*
